item.title: East Islip Friendly’s property sold to new owner
item.description: A Friendly’s restaurant property in East Islip sold for $1.8M.

item.title: Mother Cabrini Health Foundation awards $16M on Long Island
item.description: Mother Cabrini Health Foundation awarded $16M to 32 Long Island nonprofits to expand healthcare access, mental health services, workforce support and basic needs.

item.title: RXR breaks ground on new Garvies Point apartments
item.description: RXR has begun construction on The Arden, a 101-unit luxury rental building at the $1.3B Garvies Point redevelopment in Glen Cove.

item.title: CBIZ names James Aspromonti Long Island office managing director
item.description: CBIZ appoints James Aspromonti as Long Island managing director as longtime leader Carolyn Mazzenga retires after years of community and firm leadership

item.title: Court allows $700M Sunrise Wind project to resume
item.description: A federal court injunction allows Ørsted’s 924-MW Sunrise Wind offshore project near Montauk to restart construction after a federal lease suspension.

item.title: On Long Island, a new networking group puts focus on building relationships
item.description: Nooks & Socials launches an invitation-only Long Island business community focused on networking, collaboration and relationship-driven growth

item.title: Survey finds retailer optimism, though rising costs remain a concern
item.description: Levin Management survey shows retailers expect stronger 2026 sales, but inflation, rising costs and labor challenges remain top concerns.

item.title: Study: Farmingdale State College drove $1B economic impact, 10K jobs
item.description: A new LIA Research Institute study found Farmingdale State College drove nearly $1 billion in economic impact and supported almost 10,000 jobs across Long Island from 2020–2025.
